hooks.command: p=$(/usr/bin/head -c 65536); /bin/cat >/dev/null; [ -n "$(/usr/bin/lsappinfo find bundleid=com.tinycast.app.fork)" ] || exit 0; s=$(printf '%s' "$p" | /usr/bin/sed -n 's/.*"session_id" *: *"\([0-9A-Za-z-]\{1,64\}\)".*/\1/p' | /usr/bin/head -n 1); n=$(printf '%s' "$p" | /usr/bin/sed -n 's/.*"notification_type" *: *"\([a-z_]\{1,40\}\)".*/\1/p' | /usr/bin/head -n 1); /usr/bin/open -g -b com.tinycast.app.fork "tinycast://agent-sessions/event?v=1&k=0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef&agent=codex&event=working&session=$s&kind=$n&pid=$PPID"; exit 0
